change: Bind contextual end to its own NDArray axis. Preserve once-only receiver evaluation and once-only length evaluation for custom indexers.
validation: 214 focused checks passed in 8.48s; independent three-generation C bootstrap followed by 355 numeric/end checks passed in 8.58s; Ruff and git diff --check passed.
before: For reshape([1 2 3 4 5 6] 2 3), m[end end] returned 5, and assigning to it changed element [1 1]. It now returns 6 and updates [1 2].
coverage: Native/web, default/release, non-square matrices and 3D/4D arrays
Scalar, range and compound updates, empty axes, nested field/array update receivers evaluated once, reads snapshot before index callbacks mutate original binding
Existing array/string end checks and custom multi-index length callback evaluated once
limits: This is a correctness/ergonomics change; no performance improvement claimed. The helper only runs for bracket expressions that contain contextual end.
